sloka: शेषा हता महावीर्या राक्षसा रण मूर्धनि ।घोरा दुर्विषहाः सर्वे लक्ष्मणस्य अग्रजेन ॥३-२६-३७॥
transliteration: śeṣā hatā mahāvīryā rākṣasā raṇa mūrdhani ।ghorā durviṣahāḥ sarve lakṣmaṇasya agrajena ॥3-26-37॥

translations.english: The rest of the mighty, dreadful, intolerable demons were killed on the war front by Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana.
